title: Zechariah Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on Zechariah 4: the golden lamp stand and the two olive trees, the word to Zerubbabel, and the two anointed ones.

questions.text: How does the text describe the way the angel wakened Zechariah?
questions.explanation: The angel who talked with him came again and wakened him, as a man who is wakened out of his sleep.

answers.text: As a man called from a field
As a man wakened out of his sleep
As a man roused by a trumpet
As a man risen from the dead

questions.text: What did Zechariah say he saw when the angel asked what he saw?
questions.explanation: He said he had seen a lamp stand all of gold, with its bowl on the top of it and its seven lamps on it.

answers.text: A lamp stand all of gold

questions.text: How many lamps were on the lamp stand?
questions.explanation: The lamp stand had its bowl on the top of it and its seven lamps on it, with seven pipes to each of the lamps.

questions.text: What stood by the lamp stand, one on each side of the bowl?
questions.explanation: There were two olive trees by it, one on the right side of the bowl and the other on the left side of it.

questions.text: How does Yahweh's word to Zerubbabel say the work will be done?
questions.explanation: The word to Zerubbabel is, "Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit," says Yahweh of Armies.

answers.text: By the hand of the king
By his Spirit, not by might or power
By the sword of a mighty man

questions.text: What will the great mountain become before Zerubbabel?
questions.explanation: The great mountain becomes a plain before Zerubbabel, and he will bring out the capstone with shouts of "Grace, grace, to it!"

questions.text: Whose hands had laid the foundation of this house, and would also finish it?
questions.explanation: The hands of Zerubbabel had laid the foundation of this house, and his hands would also finish it.

questions.text: What are the seven said to be, which run back and forth through the whole earth?
questions.explanation: The text says these seven are Yahweh's eyes, which run back and forth through the whole earth.

answers.text: The four winds of the sky

questions.text: What did Zechariah ask about the second time?
questions.explanation: He asked about the two olive branches, which are beside the two golden spouts that pour the golden oil out of themselves.

answers.text: The seven pipes of the lamps
The two olive branches beside the golden spouts
The bowl on the top of the lamp stand
The plumb line in Zerubbabel's hand

questions.text: What did the angel answer when Zechariah said he did not know what these were?
questions.explanation: The angel said, "These are the two anointed ones who stand by the Lord of the whole earth."

answers.text: The two houses of Israel and Judah
The two witnesses of the covenant
The two kings of the north country
The two anointed ones who stand by the Lord
